expected: Multiple sandboxed previews load under the strict CSP with no console errors, uncaught exceptions, or failed essential requests.

before.result: WebKit reported one style-src-elem violation for each mounted preview frame.
before.rootCause: The sampled no-op inline style is reported by WebKit, but its producer is not identified. No application-side style node or insertion trace was present when the violation event fired.

remediation: The Sites artifact generator adds the exact SHA-256 source for the sampled `body {}` rule to style-src and style-src-elem. The rule has no CSS declarations. No general unsafe-inline source was added.

after.targetedWebKitTests: 10 passed across desktop and mobile: two complete workloads and eight CSP scenarios.

securityImpact: No unsafe-inline source was added to style-src or style-src-elem. The sole added hash permits the exact empty body rule; script-src and style-src-attr policy are unchanged.
